_meta.claim: Go ComputeDayFestivals derives the same FestivalComputeContext from the same place and date as the TypeScript, and therefore emits the same festival list. The anchor digest pins the nine kala instants separately, because a wrong anchor is usually absorbed by the output.
_meta.note: Driven through getDailyPanchang rather than computeDayFestivals directly, so the sunrise triple, the Bhadra window and the unclamped moonrise are the ones panchang.ts hands it, the seam is part of the claim.
